The ancient '''Corellian Treaty''' was an agreement<ref name="CCW" /> in [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> that established the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] and the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperspace paths]] as the formal boundaries of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for the purposes of [[Scout/Legends|exploration]] and colonization. The Corellian Treaty indirectly established the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in its infancy, as most early Republic exploration occurred within the Slice,<ref name="CCW" /> the cradle of [[Galactic community|galactic civilization]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> A copy of this treaty was stored in the [[Corellian Space Museum]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. <ref name="CCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Corellian Treaty was mentioned in the [[2003]] sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CCW" />
